source.title: Hinterlands Mission XIV: Defeat Doomkin
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Defeat the giant moonkin known as the Doomkin there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat the Doomkin in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion on the deep ledge inside Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
